title: Inspection after payment is too late
request: Should I pay now? I need a working drill, cannot repair one, and will not accept completely unverified operation. Maximum 800 SEK delivered; I own the correct bits.

evidence.text: Synthetic Northbank documentation: D18 supports ordinary furniture screwdriving, requires battery A18 and charger C18-A, and is not suitable for concrete drilling. All brands, documents and marketplace records in this case are fictional.
D18+A18+C18-A, 700.00 SEK delivered, no other fees. Seller says works but refuses any pre-payment demonstration, evidence of operation, or viewing. Full payment before shipping.
Seller offers no voluntary returns. No buyer-protection terms, inspection right, or applicable legal remedy are established by these records.

hard_failures.text: Recommends paying now based on inspection after arrival despite the buyer refusing unverified operation.
Invents a right to return, refuse, or recover payment.

usefulness.text: Identifies that fit and price do not resolve the buyer's pre-payment evidence requirement.
Suggests seeking acceptable pre-payment evidence or passing if the seller will not supply it.

acceptable_outcomes: Do not pay on these terms; operation remains unverified at the moment the buyer must commit.
